hero.filename: JT610 Pitch and Total Velocity; final 2 minutes of Flight.png
hero.caption: This is "Granualar ADSB" flight data downloaded from FlightRadar24.  I converted horizontal and vertical speeds to MPH and used their arc-tangent to infer the pitch angle of the plane.  Also computed the magnitude of the total velocity vector.  (other plots only show ground speed, but unfortunately the vertical speed was a significant part of the total at the end of the flight)
